title: APPLICATION FOR REGISTRATION OF AN INSTRUMENTATION BUSINESS
full_text:
■ Enforcement Rule of the Prevention of Steep Slope Disasters Act [Attached Form 6] <Amended 2020.9.8>

APPLICATION FOR REGISTRATION OF AN INSTRUMENTATION BUSINESS

(Front)

| Receipt number | Date of receipt | Processing period |
|---|---|---|
| ____________________ | ____________________ | 14 days |

| Section | Field | Entry |
|---|---|---|
| Applicant | Name | ____________________ |
| | Date of birth | ____________________ |
| | Address | ____________________ (Telephone number: ____________________) |
| Application particulars | Trade name | ____________________ |
| | Registration number | ____________________ |
| | Date of registration | Year _____ Month _____ Day _____ |
| | Location of principal place of business | ____________________ |

I hereby apply for registration of an instrumentation business pursuant to Article 22(1) of the Prevention of Steep Slope Disasters Act, Article 12(1) of the Enforcement Decree of that Act, and Article 8(1) of the Enforcement Rule of that Act.

Year _____ Month _____ Day _____

Applicant ____________________ (Signature or seal)

To: Mayor/Do Governor

ATTACHMENTS

Documents to be submitted by the applicant:
1. A list of the representative and executive officers.
2. A list of the technical personnel employed and their construction technology career certificates issued pursuant to Article 21 of the Construction Technology Promotion Act (only where verification of practical experience is necessary).
3. A specification of the instrumentation equipment and 1 copy of the performance inspection reports for the instrumentation equipment.
4. 1 copy of documents proving completion of the practical education and training course under Article 30(1) of the Prevention of Steep Slope Disasters Act.

Matters to be verified by the public official in charge:
1. Certification of business registration or a certificate of registered corporate particulars (only in the case of a corporation).
2. Confirmation of the acquisition of national technical qualifications by the technical personnel employed.

Fee: 20,000 won

CONSENT TO THE JOINT USE OF ADMINISTRATIVE INFORMATION

I consent to the public official in charge verifying the matters listed above for official verification, in connection with the processing of this matter, through the joint use of administrative information pursuant to Article 36 of the Electronic Government Act.
* If consent is withheld, the applicant shall submit the relevant documents directly.

Applicant ____________________ (Signature or seal)

210 mm × 297 mm [white woodfree paper, 80 g/m²]

(Back)

PROCESSING PROCEDURE

This application is processed as follows.

| Applicant | Processing authority (Special Metropolitan City, Metropolitan City, Special Self-Governing City, Do, or Special Self-Governing Province) |
|---|---|
| Submit application → | Receive application |
| | ↓ Review whether registration may be granted |
| | ↓ Approval |
| Certificate delivered to applicant ← | Issue registration certificate |
